constraints: If metaName is a tag path, metaContents directly receives the value (converted to the variable's declared type, Text by default; Text results are XMP-formatted XML); pass an array if the tag can hold more than one value (e.g. IPTC Keywords).
If metaName is a block name ("TIFF", "EXIF", "GPS", "IPTC") or an empty string, metaContents must instead be a valid XML DOM element reference, into which the designated block(s) are copied.

overloadMerges.note: Corrected direction: metaContents (both the leading pair and each repeated pair) is filled in by the command ('←' in the docs), not passed in.

params.name: metaName
params.description: Name or tag path of the metadata block to get; a constant from the Picture Metadata Names theme, a block name ("TIFF", "EXIF", "GPS", "IPTC"), or an empty string.
